## Technical Context

### Architecture

Same vertical-slice shape as `src/lib/recipes` and `src/lib/pantry`:

- **Migration** `supabase/migrations/0005_meal_plans.sql` creates enums + `meal_plans` + `planned_meals`, constraints encoding INV-PL-001/002/003/004/012, RLS, indexes, `updated_at` triggers (reuses existing `set_updated_at()`).
- **Service layer** (`planningService.ts`) wraps supabase-js: implicit week-plan acquisition, planned-meal CRUD, move/re-home, range listing for any calendar view.
- **State layer** (`planStore.svelte.ts`) runes-based store holding a date-range cache of planned meals keyed by date, with optimistic add/edit/move/remove and server reconciliation (P15).
- **UI** one route `src/routes/plan/+page.svelte` with a view switcher (Day / Week / Month) over shared components; add/edit/move sheets.

### Database Tables

- `meal_slot` enum: `BREAKFAST | LUNCH | DINNER | SNACK` (nullable column = "Anytime", per Domain Spec §2.4)
- `planned_meal_source` enum: `RECIPE | PREPPED | STORE_BOUGHT | QUICK` (full domain enum; `PREPPED` not creatable via UI this chunk, A-003)
- `planned_meal_status` enum: `PLANNED | LOGGED | SKIPPED | SWAPPED` (only `PLANNED` written this chunk, A-002)
- `meal_plans`: id, owner_id, household_id (nullable, no FK yet — same convention as pantry_items), name (nullable), start_date, end_date, timestamps. CHECK end ≥ start (INV-PL-001). **Unique `(owner_id, start_date)`** — one implicit plan per week per owner (FR-PL-011).
- `planned_meals`: id, meal_plan_id FK, date, meal_slot (nullable), source, recipe_id FK `ON DELETE SET NULL`, recipe_title_snapshot, prepped_meal_id (nullable, reserved), store_bought_name, quick_meal_name, servings CHECK > 0 (INV-PL-004), status default PLANNED, logged_at CHECK pairing (INV-PL-005), sort_order, timestamps.
  - CHECK exactly-one-source matching `source` (INV-PL-003)
  - `UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (meal_plan_id, date, meal_slot, sort_order)` (INV-PL-012)
  - Trigger validating `date BETWEEN plan.start_date AND plan.end_date` (INV-PL-002 — cross-row, so trigger not CHECK)

### File Structure

```
supabase/migrations/0005_meal_plans.sql       # schema + RLS + triggers
src/lib/planning/
  types.ts                                    # MealSlot, PlannedMealSource, PlannedMeal, MealPlan, draft types
  weekMath.ts                                 # ISO Monday-start week helpers over civil-date strings (A-009)
  weekMath.spec.ts
  planningService.ts                          # supabase-js data access (see contracts/planning-service.md)
  planningService.spec.ts
  planStore.svelte.ts                         # runes store: range cache, optimistic ops
  index.ts                                    # public re-exports
  components/
    PlanCalendar.svelte                       # view switcher shell (Day/Week/Month, prev/next, Today)
    WeekView.svelte
    DayView.svelte
    MonthView.svelte
    SlotBand.svelte                           # one slot group (band) for a day: meals + add affordance + drop target
    MealCard.svelte                           # name, source kind, servings; draggable on pointer devices
    AddMealSheet.svelte                       # source tabs: Recipe (picker) / Store-bought / Quick
    MealDetailSheet.svelte                    # edit servings/slot/source details; Move; Remove
    MoveMealSheet.svelte                      # tap-based date+slot picker
src/routes/plan/+page.svelte                  # Plan tab route
src/routes/+layout.svelte                     # + nav link "Plan"
src/lib/database.types.ts                     # regenerated via bun run db:types
tests/plan.e2e.ts                             # Playwright flow
```

### Key Patterns

- **Implicit plans**: `getOrCreatePlanForWeek(dateISO)` computes Monday-start week bounds (A-009) and upserts on `(owner_id, start_date)` conflict — race-safe, no plan UI (FR-PL-011).
- **Append ordering**: new/moved meals get `sort_order = max(group) + 1` computed server-side via a `select` then insert; unique constraint is the integrity backstop (FR-PL-010, INV-PL-012).
- **Cross-week move**: `movePlannedMeal` re-homes to the target week's plan (auto-create) then updates date/slot/sort (FR-PL-015).
- **Recipe snapshot**: `recipe_title_snapshot` captured at creation; FK `ON DELETE SET NULL` keeps plans intact if a recipe is deleted (FR-PL-019, A-005).
- **Civil dates as strings**: `date` columns travel as `YYYY-MM-DD` strings end-to-end; "today" computed client-side in the user's local timezone (A-006). No `Date`-at-midnight-UTC bugs.
- **DnD**: HTML5 `draggable` on `MealCard`, `dragover`/`drop` on `SlotBand` (pointer devices); `MoveMealSheet` is the accessible path everywhere (FR-PL-013).
- **Optimistic UI**: store applies the mutation locally, fires the service call, reconciles with the returned row or rolls back on error with a toast (P15).

## Phase 0: Research

See [research.md](./research.md). Decisions:

1. Implicit week-plan acquisition via upsert on unique `(owner_id, start_date)`
2. INV-PL-012 via `UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT` (Postgres 15+; Supabase ships 15/17)
3. INV-PL-002 via BEFORE INSERT/UPDATE trigger (cross-row check)
4. Native HTML5 drag-and-drop, no library
5. Recipe deletion handled by snapshot + `ON DELETE SET NULL`
6. Week math hand-rolled on civil-date strings (no date library)

### API Contracts

See [contracts/planning-service.md](./contracts/planning-service.md) — `planningService` function signatures (the "API" of this SPA is PostgREST via supabase-js; the service module is the contract surface).

## Implementation Phases

### Phase A: Database (do first — everything depends on schema)

1. Write `supabase/migrations/0005_meal_plans.sql`:
   - enums `meal_slot`, `planned_meal_source`, `planned_meal_status`
   - `meal_plans` with INV-PL-001 CHECK + unique `(owner_id, start_date)`
   - `planned_meals` with INV-PL-003/004/005 CHECKs, INV-PL-012 unique index, INV-PL-002 trigger
   - RLS default-deny + owner policies on both tables (P7), realtime publication, `set_updated_at` triggers
2. Apply locally (`supabase db reset` or `migration up`), regenerate `src/lib/database.types.ts` via `bun run db:types`

### Phase B: Foundation modules

3. `src/lib/planning/types.ts` — domain types mirroring data-model.md
4. `src/lib/planning/weekMath.ts` (+ spec) — `mondayOf`, `weekRangeOf`, `monthGridRange`, `addDays`, `todayLocalISO`, formatting helpers; pure functions, exhaustive unit tests (ISO Monday-start, year boundaries, DST-proof string math)

### Phase C: Service + State

5. `planningService.ts` (+ spec, mocked supabase client) — see contract: `getOrCreatePlanForWeek`, `listPlannedMeals(from,to)`, `addPlannedMeal(draft)`, `updatePlannedMeal(id, patch)`, `movePlannedMeal(id, {date, slot})`, `removePlannedMeal(id)`
6. `planStore.svelte.ts` — range-keyed cache (`mealsByDate`), `loadRange`, optimistic `add`/`update`/`move`/`remove` with rollback, `pending`/`error` state

### Phase D: UI

7. `PlanCalendar.svelte` — view switcher (Day/Week/Month), period nav, Today; persists chosen view to `localStorage` (A-001)
8. `WeekView` / `DayView` / `MonthView` — week is default; month renders compact day summaries navigating to Day view (FR-PL-001/004)
9. `SlotBand.svelte` + `MealCard.svelte` — slot bands incl. "Anytime" group, ordered meals, empty-state copy ("Nothing planned") (FR-PL-002/003, FR-PL-020)
10. `AddMealSheet.svelte` — slot pre-fill, three source tabs (recipe picker w/ search over `recipesRepository`, store-bought text, quick options Takeout/Leftovers/custom), servings default (FR-PL-005..008, FR-PL-021)
11. `MealDetailSheet.svelte` + `MoveMealSheet.svelte` — edit/remove + tap-move (FR-PL-012/013/014)
12. Drag-and-drop wiring on Week/Day views (FR-PL-013); route `src/routes/plan/+page.svelte`; nav link in `+layout.svelte`

### Phase E: Tests

13. Unit: `weekMath.spec.ts`, `planningService.spec.ts` (source exclusivity, append ordering, cross-week move re-homing)
14. E2E `tests/plan.e2e.ts`: plan a recipe + store-bought + quick meal, multi-meal slot, move across days, edit servings, remove, reload persistence (SC-001..004)

## Out of Scope (this feature)

Per spec Scope: fulfillment derivation (REQ-MP-012/INV-PL-017), `PREPPED` source UI,
suggestions/generation, `MealScheduleRule` recurrence, nutrition rollups, logging flows,
household sharing/Realtime UI, shopping-list generation. Schema deliberately reserves
`PREPPED`, `status` values, and `household_id` so those chunks need no rework.
